name: Alanís (Spain)
description: Dark blue field charged at the centre with the arms of Alanís (a yellow castle between two white horses beneath a crescent and a star, with a key below).
history: Municipal flag of Alanís; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alanís arms — castle between two horses beneath a crescent and a star, with a key
